name: Forcing Someone Sexually
overview: Scripture reveals God's design for human relationships as one of unity and respect, exemplified in Genesis 2:24 where a man and wife become one flesh, highlighting the sanctity of marriage. The presence of oppression and power imbalance, as noted in Ecclesiastes 4:1, underscores the distress caused when individuals are subjected to force or domination without comfort or justice. God's redemptive love, demonstrated in John 3:16, calls believers to reflect His character by honoring others and rejecting any form of coercion, especially in intimate relationships.
